text: Open eganyé and tap Create an account.
Enter your name, your email and a password.
You get a code by email. Type it in here.
Choose what you want to do. Here, start a tontine.
This is your home screen: your balance, your circles, your latest activity.
The assistant tells you what matters today. For example, why your score moved.
Ask it your questions: it answers from your own contributions.
In Circles, tap the plus, then Create a circle.
Name your circle, then set the contribution and the number of members.
Pick how often you pay, the start date, and how to choose who gets the pot.
Check the summary, accept, and sign.
Your circle is ready. Share the code, or invite your people on WhatsApp.
When it’s time to pay in, open your circle and tap Contribute.
The AI also estimates the risk of delay for the round, without naming anyone.
The pot fills up with every contribution, and everyone can see it.
Once everyone has paid in, the organizer distributes the pot.
When it’s your turn, the money lands in your wallet.
To top up, choose the amount.
Check the fees, pay, then confirm on your phone.
To withdraw, choose the amount.
Double-check the number: a completed transfer can’t be reversed.
Check the summary.
Enter your PIN, and you’re done.
That’s all you need. Welcome to eganyé.
